title: Irrigation and Root-Zone Observation Log
description: A structured worksheet for recording irrigation events, source and drain measurements, root-zone observations, and exceptions.
instructions: Record units for every numeric measurement.
Separate measured data from visual observations and decisions.
Escalate out-of-range results through the applicable site procedure.
limitations: This template does not prescribe nutrient recipes, irrigation timing, or corrective actions.
Sampling method and acceptance limits must come from the applicable course exercise or approved SOP.
